Package com.codedstream.otterstream.context.vector

Class PineconeContextProvider

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.context.vector.PineconeContextProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, VectorSearchProvider
public class PineconeContextProvider extends Object implements VectorSearchProvider
VectorSearchProvider backed by Pinecone's REST query API. Uses the JDK's own HttpClient and jackson-databind (already transitively available via ml-inference-core) — no Pinecone SDK dependency, matching the same zero-new-dependency reasoning as RestDecisionEngineConnector in otter-stream-rules.

Index host, stated plainly: Pinecone's query endpoint host is per-index (https://{index}-{project}.svc.{environment}.pinecone.io/query for pod-based indexes, a different host shape for serverless indexes) — pass your index's actual query host as indexHost; this class doesn't derive it for you, since that mapping is account/plan -specific and not something to guess at. For Milvus or OpenSearch instead, implement VectorSearchProvider directly against their own query APIs — this class is Pinecone -specific by design, the same "one concrete example, generic interface for the rest" approach used for DecisionEngineConnector's REST connector.

Usage


 VectorSearchProvider pinecone = new PineconeContextProvider(
         "pinecone-docs",
         "https://my-index-abc123.svc.us-east-1-aws.pinecone.io",
         System.getenv("PINECONE_API_KEY"),
         "default");

 List<VectorMatch> matches = pinecone.search(queryEmbedding, 5);
